The claws on the front paws show minor fusion/indistinctness, lacking sharp separation from paw pads. The right lion's rear paw connection to the base exhibits slight geometric softness/ambiguity. These are localized AI generation artifacts in complex geometry. The topology boundary auditor confirmed strong mask confidence (0.9997), indicating overall structural coherence despite these minor flaws. The image reads as a plausible photograph of wooden sculptures.
